construction: Shared outer grid and inner chords offset along interpolated source vertex normals. Depth struts at lattice nodes, alternating diagonals in both parameter directions, closed perimeter depth.
limitations: Nominal truss depth and tube width are published; grid pitch and phase remain authoring assumptions.
Aligned inner lattice and alternating diagonal phase are a construction hypothesis supported only qualitatively by photographs; not a fabrication reconstruction.
Outer square tubes are centered on the registered source envelope. The 2 m dimension is modeled between chord centerlines; exact outside-to-outside convention is unverified.
Source curvature is coarse; inner chords split at lattice joints and source-facet boundaries to preserve normal-offset connections. Collinear runs are merged.
Branch junctions, support bearings, member end joints, Skyway attachment, western and eastern flares remain unfinished.
